meta.purpose: Candidate personality profiles for the Study-3 human evaluation. Six are selected from these by experiments/rq3/select_personas.py on measured behavioural separation; the rest are recorded as rejected candidates.
design_rules: R1 — each profile has at least two traits at |value| >= 0.6, so no profile is behaviourally flat.
R2 — every trait takes both a high and a low value across the candidate set, so no trait is untestable by construction.
R3 — descriptions name dispositions only. Naming a place or an activity would turn the three-alternative identification task into word matching and inflate every policy's score.
meta.description_limits: three short clauses, <= 20 characters (zh) / <= 12 words (en), matched length across candidates
